# Science Meets Fiction

> > A NASA astrophysicist's exploration of science fiction through podcast episodes, literary analysis, and original short stories.

Created by Alex R. Howe, a Princeton-trained astrophysicist at Goddard Space Flight Center, this site combines rigorous scientific analysis with deep dives into sci-fi literature, film, and television. Features podcast interviews with authors like Robert Silverberg, hard science fiction reviews, and original creative writing.

## Key Topics

- Alex R. Howe (NASA astrophysicist & host)
- Science fiction podcast episodes
- Hard science fiction analysis
- Literary analysis & narrative structure
- Dystopian fiction (1984, Brave New World)
- Time travel tropes
- Multiverse fiction
- Astrophysics & astronomy
- Writing advice for sci-fi authors
- Classic sci-fi authors (Larry Niven, Robert Silverberg, Stephen Baxter)
- Inverted Hero's Journey framework
- The Orville & sci-fi television
- A Reader's History of Science Fiction
- Princeton University & Goddard Space Flight Center

## About & Core Pages

- [Science Meets Fiction](https://sciencemeetsfiction.com): Homepage featuring podcast episodes and sci-fi commentary by Alex R. Howe
- [About Me](https://sciencemeetsfiction.com/about): NASA astrophysicist & sci-fi writer from Princeton/Goddard Space Flight
- [Short Stories](https://sciencemeetsfiction.com/short-stories): Self-published sci-fi stories: aliens, AI, generation ships, superheroes

## Podcast Interviews & Episodes

- [S3E2: Robert Silverberg Interview](https://sciencemeetsfiction.com/2024/07/01/s3e2-robert-silverberg-interview): Golden Age sci-fi author Silverberg on career from Asimov era to present
- [S2E10: Interview: Brown and Hansen on Stephen King](https://sciencemeetsfiction.com/2022/10/17/s2e10-interview-brown-and-hansen-on-stephen-king): Panel interview with Stephen King scholars Brown and Hansen on horror/sci-fi
- [#35 – Time Travel Part II: Wibbly Wobbly Timey Wimey](https://sciencemeetsfiction.com/2021/09/27/35-time-travel-part-ii-wibbly-wobbly-timey-wimey): Podcast exploring ten time travel tropes from Doctor Who to Stephen Baxter
- [S2E19: Multiverse Fiction](https://sciencemeetsfiction.com/2023/02/20/s2e19-multiverse-fiction): Podcast on multiverse sci-fi from Pratchett/Baxter to Marvel/DC Comics

## Literary Analysis & Essays

- [Dystopia as an Inverted Hero's Journey](https://sciencemeetsfiction.com/nonfiction-essays/dystopia-as-an-inverted-heros-journey): Essay analyzing classic dystopian novels through Campbell's framework
- [Dystopia as an Inverted Hero's Journey: Introduction](https://sciencemeetsfiction.com/2019/07/06/dystopia-as-an-inverted-heros-journey-introduction): Intro to analyzing 1984, Brave New World via inverted Hero's Journey
- [Dystopia as an Inverted Hero's Journey: Act II](https://sciencemeetsfiction.com/2019/07/13/dystopia-as-an-inverted-heros-journey-act-ii): Literary analysis of dystopian narrative structure using Campbell's theory
- [Harry Potter Theory: Muggles v. Wizards: Who Would Win?](https://sciencemeetsfiction.com/harry-potter-theory-muggles-v-wizards-who-would-win): Analysis of hypothetical warfare between muggles and wizards post-Ukraine

## Science Fiction Reviews & Analysis

- [The Science of Project Hail Mary](https://sciencemeetsfiction.com/2021/06/15/the-science-of-project-hail-mary): Scientific accuracy analysis of Andy Weir's hard sci-fi novel
- [Reading Levels and the Surprisingly Recent Stratification of Children's Books](https://sciencemeetsfiction.com/2022/03/02/reading-levels-and-the-surprisingly-recent-stratification-of-childrens-books): History of reading levels and age stratification in children's publishing

## Writing Advice & Craft

- [How to be a writer: how much feedback?](https://sciencemeetsfiction.com/2013/06/27/how-to-be-a-writer-how-much-feedback): Writing advice on getting feedback from beta readers and target audience
- [How to be a writer in 1 easy step](https://sciencemeetsfiction.com/2013/01/25/how-to-be-a-writer-in-1-easy-step): Writing motivation advice: overcoming procrastination and just write
- [On New Year's Resolutions](https://sciencemeetsfiction.com/2019/03/31/on-new-years-resolutions): Goal-setting strategies using SMART goals and weekly schedules for writers

## Science & Mathematics

- [New Video: The Recamán Sequence](https://sciencemeetsfiction.com/2021/01/10/new-video-the-recaman-sequence): Mathematical visualization of Recamán sequence using Python animation
- [What If? Rejects #5.1: Balancing Act](https://sciencemeetsfiction.com/2015/04/20/what-if-rejects-5-1-balancing-act): Supervolcano vs global warming: could Yellowstone balance climate change?
- [What If? Rejects #6.1: A Well-Balanced Meal, Part 2](https://sciencemeetsfiction.com/2015/05/31/what-if-rejects-6-1-a-well-balanced-meal-part-2): Nutritional analysis answering Randall Munroe's rejected What If? question
- [In the sky: Comet PanSTARRS is here](https://sciencemeetsfiction.com/2013/03/09/in-the-sky-comet-panstarrs-is-here): Astronomy guide to viewing Comet PanSTARRS in 2013 northern skies
